Subject: Proposed MAP + acceptance runway (initial)

Alicia — attaching a draft MAP and a suggested acceptance/runway that aligns MSA, DPA and order-form sequencing so we can close by mid-Aug. High-level asks: 

- Can you confirm (by EOD Mon) whether NovaForge legal will accept the standard Redwood DPA or if you expect material redlines?
- If there are DPA redlines, please flag the top 3 items so we can prioritize internal review and spin a response.
- We’ve sketched a path where MSA signature precedes order-form; DPA finalization is the critical dependency for go-live data access.

Attached: Redwood_MAP_v0.3.xlsx (MAP with milestones), MSA_redwood_v2.docx (clean copy)

Suggested timeline (proposal):
- Jul 4–8: Legal review (NovaForge)
- Jul 9–14: Redwood response / negotiation window
- Jul 15: MSA sign target (if redlines limited)
- Jul 20: DPA sign target (critical path)
- Jul 22: Order-form and first invoice

If we move the DPA earlier in parallel with MSA redline discussion we can compress to an earlier go-live; that requires NovaForge legal to prioritize the DPA team. Let me know who I should loop in on your side.

Thanks,
Olga
Olga Petrov

Thanks for the kickoff, Olga. Two operational notes to keep the close predictable: 

1) Dependency matrix (who owns what):
- NovaForge legal: DPA redline and confirmation on subprocessors/data residency (Alicia)
- Redwood legal (me): review and produce counter-redline within 48 hrs of receiving prioritized items
- Redwood CS (Vanessa): map acceptance criteria that require production data access; these should be gated behind DPA finalization
- Sales (Olga): coordinate signature sequencing and PO/order-form issuance post-MSA

2) Compression options if NovaForge can fast-track DPA: we can run parallel MSA sign and DPA review; order-form can be signed as a contingent signature (conditional on DPA clauses). That reduces go-live risk but requires explicit approval from NovaForge procurement to issue a PO before final DPA.

Proposed mini-sprint calendar (internal to Redwood):
- Jul 7: Receive prioritized DPA items from NovaForge
- Jul 7–8: Redwood legal counter-draft
- Jul 9: Joint review call (20–30m) to resolve top 3 items
- Jul 10–14: Finalize MSA/DPA redlines and prepare signature-ready docs

Alicia — can NovaForge commit to the Jul 9 call window? If yes, I’ll book.

-Karthik
Sr. Counsel, Contracts — Redwood Inference

Subject: Acceptance criteria & MAP detail (v0.3)

Alicia — attaching the MAP workbook with the acceptance runway tab filled out. Key acceptance items that block order-form invoicing: 

• Test workspace provisioning with synthetic data (no PHI)
• Integration check: SSO + scoped API keys validated
• Performance smoke test: median latency under 400ms for sample pipeline
• Data ingestion validation and retention settings confirmed

If DPA is not complete before test workspace provisioning, we’ll only provision a sandbox with synthetic data; production data access will be gated behind the DPA signature.

Attachments: Redwood_MAP_v0.3.xlsx (updated with acceptance gates)

Vanessa Ortiz
